# textpath.py

[简体中文](textpath.zh.md) ｜ **English** ｜ [← Back to README](../../README.en.md)

TextPathElement: text laid out along a path.

---

## Classes and methods

### `TextPathElement`

Text-path element: text laid out along a path.

---

## Full example

Run it directly in PyCharm, or from the command line: `python malight/elements/textpath.py`

```python
if __name__ == "__main__":
    import os

    from malight import Malight, ColorName, Font, FontWeight

    _out = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__),
                                        "..", "..", "output"))
    pen = Malight(os.path.join(_out, "demo_textpath"), width=660, height=380)
    pen.set_background_color(ColorName.WHITESMOKE)

    # 1) Text along a polyline of points, the simplest form
    pen.textPath([(60, 100), (200, 50), (340, 100), (480, 50)],
                 "text along a polyline", font=Font.SIMHEI, font_size=24,
                 fill_color=ColorName.NAVY)

    # 2) The guide can be a PathElement, which curves more smoothly
    guide = pen.path(fill_color="none", stroke_color=ColorName.LIGHTGRAY,
                     stroke_width=1, stroke_style="4 4")
    guide.move_to(60, 210)
    guide.cubic_to((180, 110), (320, 310), (460, 210))
    pen.textPath(guide, "text flowing along a cubic Bezier",
                 font_size=20, fill_color=ColorName.CRIMSON,
                 weight=FontWeight.SEMI_BOLD)

    # 3) start_offset moves the text: "0%" at the start, "50%" centred
    pen.textPath([(60, 300), (600, 300)], "start_offset=50% starts in the middle",
                 start_offset="50%", font_size=19,
                 fill_color=ColorName.TEAL)

    # 4) Text on a circular path, for stamps and badges:
    #    move_to one point, then circle_to closes the circle at that radius
    ring = pen.path(fill_color="none", stroke_color=ColorName.LIGHTGRAY,
                    stroke_width=1)
    ring.move_to(330, 260)
    ring.circle_to((330, 330))
    pen.textPath(ring, "· text around a circle ·", font_size=16,
                 fill_color=ColorName.INDIGO)
    print("Note: the guide path moves into <defs> and is not drawn")

    # 5) Partial update: only size and spacing change; text and guide stay
    tp = pen.textPath([(60, 360), (600, 360)], "partial update demo", font_size=16)
    tp.update(font_size=22, letter_spacing=6, fill_color=ColorName.SEAGREEN)
    # You can also swap the text or the path: internal references are rebuilt
    tp.update(text="replacement text")
    tp.update(path=[(60, 360), (330, 345), (600, 360)])
    print("textPath children:", len(tp.node.children),
          "| text:", tp.node.children[0].text if tp.node.children else None)

    pen.finish()
```
